in_hindi.name: Amritlal
in_hindi.long_meaning: एक प्यारे और जीवन का सूक्ष्म रूप जीवन-जीवन का दूरदश्त वा प्रिय वाला

in_tamil.name: Amritlal
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Nectar of the Gods
in_tamil.long_meaning: Amritlal ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Amrit means 'nectar' and Lal means 'of the gods'. This name signifies the one who is filled with the divine nectar of immortality.

in_telugu.name: Amritlal
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Nectar of the Gods
in_telugu.long_meaning: Amritlal ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Amrit means 'nectar' and Lal means 'of the gods'. This name signifies the one who is filled with the divine nectar of immortality.

in_marathi.name: Amritlal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Nectar of the Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amritlal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Amrit means 'nectar' and Lal means 'of the gods'. This name signifies the one who is filled with the divine nectar of immortality.

in_bengali.name: Amritlal
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Nectar of the Gods
in_bengali.long_meaning: Amritlal একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Amrit means 'nectar' and Lal means 'of the gods'. This name signifies the one who is filled with the divine nectar of immortality.
